information_and_model_claim.modeling_question: Can direction-preserving nonlinear calibration and conditional complementarity across the complete frozen 140-feature library improve three-session portability beyond consumed linear and deterministic aggregators?
information_and_model_claim.historical_policy_permission: Factor combinations and model fitting are allowed inside development folds when the entire reused library and finite search space are frozen; prior factor records remain terminal.

nearest_consumed_families.distinction: Campaign132 fits shallow monotone histogram trees with neutral missing fill and three fixed interaction constraints; it does not refit, regrid or relax the bounded-simplex objective.

nearest_consumed_families.family: full-library percentile consensus and lower-quartile consensus
nearest_consumed_families.distinction: Campaign132 learns training-only monotone nonlinear response shapes; it does not alter or rerun either deterministic order statistic.
The improvement-breadth factor remains one of 140 frozen inputs and is not recomputed or promoted as the model target.

nearest_consumed_families.family: unconstrained tree, neural, subset and signed-weight search
nearest_consumed_families.distinction: All are excluded. Every Campaign132 feature has monotonic constraint +1, every feature remains present, and only three enumerated interaction constraints exist.

prevalue_intervention_tests.intervention: Hold every favorable-direction component percentile fixed while changing raw OHLCV, event and accounting fields consistently with those percentiles.
prevalue_intervention_tests.result: Campaign132 scores are unchanged; the campaign is only a combination layer, not a new factor definition.

prevalue_intervention_tests.intervention: Increase any one finite favorable-direction percentile while holding the other 139 and the fitted model fixed.
prevalue_intervention_tests.result: The model score cannot decrease because all monotonic constraints are +1.

prevalue_intervention_tests.intervention: Remove any component, fit a negative direction, tune a threshold, change the interaction catalog or use validation results to change hyperparameters.
prevalue_intervention_tests.result: The campaign contract fails closed and the change would require a new recorded campaign version.

admission.reason: This is the finite complete-library model campaign contemplated by the user-frozen walk-forward policy, not a rescue or reclassification of any individual factor.
